source:
import { Node } from 'cleo'

/**
 * Hollow Keep — a weapon. Attach to each weapon node under the Player's `Weapons` group.
 *
 *   Weapons
 *   └── Weapon_StraightSword     this script; Socket: RightHand (Attach to socket, target parent)
 *       ├── Mesh                 the visible weapon — swap the model here; its local transform IS the grip
 *       ├── Light1 Light2 Light3 SoulsMove data nodes — one per attack in the moveset
 *       └── Heavy
 *
 * The weapon node itself is driven by the socket every frame, so never offset IT to fix a grip: rotate
 * and move the `Mesh` child instead (see SOULS_DEMO.md, "Swapping a weapon").
 *
 * Every attack is a child node rather than a list field, because script fields are numbers, strings,
 * booleans and vectors only. Selecting a move in the hierarchy shows its inspector; duplicating one adds
 * an attack. The chain is `lightMove` → each move's `next` → ... and `heavyMove` on its own.
 *
 * ## Hitbox
 *
 * `bladeStart`/`bladeEnd`/`bladeRadius` is a capsule along the blade, in the `Mesh` child's space (the
 * space the blade's boxes are modelled in). During an attack's active window it is swept every frame
 * against enemy hurtboxes. Generous is normal: a hitbox a little fatter than the steel reads as fair.
 *
 * Attack rating (see SoulsGameManager.attackRating):
 *
 *   AR = baseDamage × (1 + strScaling·bonus(STR) + dexScaling·bonus(DEX)),  ×0.6 if a requirement is unmet
 */
export default class SoulsWeaponNode extends Node {
  public displayName: string = 'Straight Sword'
  public baseDamage: number = 100
  /** How fully the weapon scales with each stat: 1.0 is an "A", 0.2 an "E". */
  public strScaling: number = 0.2
  public dexScaling: number = 0.8
  public strRequirement: number = 8
  public dexRequirement: number = 10
  /** Poise damage per hit, before the move's own multiplier. */
  public poiseDamage: number = 15
  /** Multiplies every move's stamina cost. */
  public staminaMul: number = 1
  /** First move of the light chain, and the heavy attack. Names of child SoulsMove nodes. */
  public lightMove: string = 'Light1'
  public heavyMove: string = 'Heavy'
  /** The blade hitbox, in the Mesh child's space. See "Hitbox" above. */
  public bladeStart: number[] = [0, 0.12, 0]
  public bladeEnd: number[] = [0, 1, 0]
  public bladeRadius: number = 0.12
  /** Marker the player looks for among its Weapons group. */
  public isWeapon: boolean = true

  /** The child SoulsMove named `name`, or null. */
  public findMove(name: string): Node {
    if (!name) return null
    const found = this.getChildByName(name)[0]
    return found && (found as any).isMove ? found : null
  }

  /** Every move, in hierarchy order. */
  public moves(): Node[] {
    return this.children.filter(c => (c as any).isMove)
  }
}

name: Weapon Move
source:
import { Node } from 'cleo'

/**
 * Hollow Keep — one attack of a weapon's moveset. Attach to a plain child node of a SoulsWeapon; the
 * node's NAME is what the weapon's `lightMove`/`heavyMove` and other moves' `next` refer to.
 *
 * ## Timing
 *
 * Three moments drive an attack, and they come from EVENT MARKERS on the clip when it has them:
 *
   *   hit       the blade becomes ACTIVE: from here until `hitEnd` it is swept every frame and damages
 *             each enemy hurtbox it touches, once per swing (SoulsHitbox)
 *   hitEnd    the blade stops being active
 *   combo     from here a buffered attack chains into `next`
 *   recover   from here a buffered roll or drink may cancel the rest of the swing
 *
 * Author them on the clip's timeline in the Animation editor. A clip with no `hit` event uses the
 * `hitTime`/`comboTime`/`recoverTime` fields below instead (CLIP seconds, i.e. before `playSpeed`), so a
 * freshly imported animation is playable straight away and only gets better once marked up.
 *
 * The clip must be IN PLACE: one-shot actions ignore root motion. Forward travel is `lunge*` below.
 */
export default class SoulsMoveNode extends Node {
  /** Animation clip played for this attack (a clip on the player's rig). */
  public clip: string = 'Souls_Sword_L1'
  public playSpeed: number = 1
  /** Multipliers on the weapon's attack rating and poise damage. */
  public damageMul: number = 1
  public poiseMul: number = 1
  public staminaCost: number = 16
  /**
   * The swing bounces off walls (`blocksSwings` bodies) it reaches before any enemy: sparks, a recoil, no
   * damage. Heavy slams turn it off and plough through.
   */
  public bounceOff: boolean = true
  /** Forward drive: from `lungeStart` (clip seconds) for `lungeSeconds`, at `lungeSpeed` m/s. */
  public lungeStart: number = 0.1
  public lungeSeconds: number = 0.15
  public lungeSpeed: number = 2.5
  /** Seconds after the swing starts during which the player can still turn toward the target. */
  public trackSeconds: number = 0.2
  /** Fallback timings, used only when the clip carries no `hit` event. Clip seconds. */
  public hitTime: number = 0.38
  public activeSeconds: number = 0.15
  public comboTime: number = 0.45
  public recoverTime: number = 0.62
  /** Name of the move a buffered light attack chains into. Empty restarts the chain. */
  public next: string = 'Light2'
  public isMove: boolean = true
}

name: Enemy
Enemy Attack
source:
import { Node } from 'cleo'

/**
 * Hollow Keep — one attack of an enemy's moveset. Attach to a plain child of the enemy's `Attacks`
 * group; the node's NAME identifies it (for `comboNext` and for the no-repeat rule).
 *
 * ## Choosing
 *
 * When its attack gap runs out, an engaged enemy picks among the attacks that are off `cooldown`, whose
 * `minRange`..`maxRange` contains the distance to the player, and whose `phase` it has reached (0/1:
 * always; 2: boss phase two only). It avoids repeating the last one when anything else fits, then rolls
 * weighted by `weight`. See SoulsGameManager.pickEnemyAttack.
 *
 * ## Timing
 *
 * A melee attack is ACTIVE from the clip's `hit` event to its `hitEnd` event (without them: from
 * `hitTime` for `activeSeconds`, clip seconds). While active, the enemy's weapon blade is swept every
 * frame against the player's hurtbox (SoulsHitbox), so it lands where the weapon actually is: a roll's
 * i-frames switch the hurtbox off, and stepping out of the arc works because the blade misses. With
 * `aoeRadius > 0` it is a slam that hits everything inside the radius at the `hit` event. With a
 * `projectileTemplate` the `cast` event fires `projectileCount` projectiles fanned over `spreadDeg`.
 *
 * ## Movement
 *
 * The enemy turns toward the player for `trackSeconds`, then commits. It lunges forward from
 * `lungeStart` (clip seconds) for `lungeSeconds` at `lungeSpeed`; `lungeToTarget` instead covers the
 * distance to the player (capped at `lungeSpeed`) — the boss's leap. Clips must be in place.
 */
export default class SoulsEnemyAttackNode extends Node {
  public clip: string = 'Souls_Enemy_Swing'
  public playSpeed: number = 1
  public damage: number = 70
  public poiseDamage: number = 20
  public minRange: number = 0
  public maxRange: number = 2.2
  public weight: number = 1
  public cooldown: number = 0
  public phase: number = 0
  public trackSeconds: number = 0.45
  public lungeStart: number = 0
  public lungeSeconds: number = 0
  public lungeSpeed: number = 0
  public lungeToTarget: boolean = false
  /** No flinch while this attack plays (poise breaks still stagger). */
  public hyperArmor: boolean = false
  /** Attack that follows immediately, without a gap, when the player is still in its range. */
  public comboNext: string = ''
  /** Fallback active window (clip seconds) for a clip without `hit`/`hitEnd` events. */
  public hitTime: number = 0.6
  public activeSeconds: number = 0.15
  /** The swing bounces off walls (`blocksSwings` bodies). Off by default: AI swings beside walls a lot. */
  public bounceOff: boolean = false
  /** Ground-slam radius. 0 is an ordinary swing. */
  public aoeRadius: number = 0
  /** Effect template spawned at the enemy's feet on a slam. */
  public impactTemplate: string = ''
  /** Projectile template; non-empty makes this a ranged attack. */
  public projectileTemplate: string = ''
  public projectileSpeed: number = 12
  public projectileCount: number = 1
  public spreadDeg: number = 0
  /** Sound cue played when the attack starts (a SoundNode name under Sounds). */
  public sound: string = 'Enemy Swing'
  public isEnemyAttack: boolean = true
}

name: Enemy Brain
source:
import { ControllerNode, Node } from 'cleo'

/**
 * Hollow Keep — an enemy's brain. Attach to the `Brain` child (the LAST child) of every enemy template,
 * a Controller node with Source: AI and Brain: Behaviour machine.
 *
 * Two jobs, both done in `onThink` — the last step of the control pass, so this frame's perception is
 * already in and the behaviour machine reads what is written here on the next frame:
 *
 * 1. **Targeting.** The engine has no factions: perception offers every other Character, and auto-acquire
 *    would have enemies chase each other. So `autoAcquire` is off and the target is the nearest NOTICED
 *    character carrying `targetMarker` (the player sets `isPlayer`). A held target is kept until
 *    perception forgets it. `SoulsEnemy.receiveHit` also writes the attacker in directly, so an enemy hit
 *    from behind turns round.
 *
 * 2. **Blackboard for the machine.** Booleans the behaviour machine switches on:
 *
 *      engage   the target is within the enemy's `engageRange`       -> Engage (the enemy script fights)
 *      leash    too far from home, or the player died                -> Return (path back to `goalPoint`)
 *      atHome   back within `homeRadius` of where it spawned         -> Idle
 *      awake    false only for a dormant boss                        -> stays Idle
 *      dead     set by the enemy on death                            -> Dead
 *
 * Leashing LATCHES: once an enemy turns for home it ignores the player until it gets there, which is
 * what stops it dithering at the edge of its range.
 */
export default class SoulsEnemyBrainNode extends ControllerNode {
  public targetMarker: string = 'isPlayer'
  /** Hysteresis on `engage`, so the hand-over does not flicker at the boundary. */
  public engageBand: number = 0.75
  public homeRadius: number = 1.2

  private _returning: boolean = false
  private _engaged: boolean = false

  onThink(delta: number) {
    const pawn = this.possessed as any
    if (!pawn) return
    const key = this.targetKey

    if (pawn.isDead) { this.setBlackboard('dead', true); return }
    this.setBlackboard('dead', false)
    this.setBlackboard('awake', pawn.isAwake !== false)

    const home = pawn.home ?? [0, 0, 0]
    this.goalPoint = [home[0], home[1], home[2]]
    const self = this.possessed.worldPosition
    const fromHome = Math.hypot(self[0] - home[0], self[2] - home[2])
    const atHome = fromHome <= this.homeRadius
    this.setBlackboard('atHome', atHome)

    // ----- acquisition (the faction filter) -----
    const held = this.getBlackboard(key)
    const heldId = typeof held === 'string' && held ? held : null
    let bestId: string = null
    let bestDistance = Infinity
    let heldRemembered = false
    for (const sighting of this.sightings) {
      const candidate = this.scene?.getNodeById(sighting.id)
      if (!candidate || !candidate.getVariable(this.targetMarker)) continue
      if (sighting.id === heldId && sighting.timeSinceSeen <= this.perception.memorySpan) heldRemembered = true
      if (!sighting.noticed) continue
      const p = candidate.worldPosition
      const d = Math.hypot(p[0] - self[0], p[1] - self[1], p[2] - self[2])
      if (d < bestDistance) { bestDistance = d; bestId = sighting.id }
    }
    // A held target written by `receiveHit` or `awaken` survives even unseen for the memory span; a boss
    // never forgets the player inside its arena.
    const heldValid = !!heldId && (heldRemembered || pawn.isBoss || this._heldFresh(heldId))
    let targetId: string = bestId ?? (heldValid ? heldId : null)
    const target: Node = targetId ? this.scene?.getNodeById(targetId) : null
    const targetDead = !!(target as any)?.isDead

    // ----- leash (latched) -----
    if (!pawn.isBoss && fromHome > (pawn.leashRange ?? 25)) this._returning = true
    if (targetDead) this._returning = true
    if (this._returning && atHome) this._returning = false
    if (this._returning) targetId = null
    this.setBlackboard('leash', this._returning)
    this.setBlackboard(key, targetId ?? undefined)

    // ----- engage band -----
    let engage = false
    if (targetId && target && pawn.isAwake !== false) {
      const p = target.worldPosition
      const d = Math.hypot(p[0] - self[0], p[2] - self[2])
      const range = pawn.engageRange ?? 4
      engage = this._engaged ? d <= range + this.engageBand : d <= range
    }
    this._engaged = engage
    this.setBlackboard('engage', engage)
  }

  /**
   * A target written in from outside perception (a hit from behind) has no sighting yet. Keep it while
   * it is within perception range, so the enemy turns and closes in rather than shrugging it off.
   */
  private _heldFresh(id: string): boolean {
    const node = this.scene?.getNodeById(id)
    if (!node || !this.possessed) return false
    const a = node.worldPosition
    const b = this.possessed.worldPosition
    return Math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[2] - b[2]) <= this.perception.range
  }
}

source:
import { Node } from 'cleo'

/**
 * Hollow Keep — a bonfire. Attach to the bonfire's root node.
 *
 *   Bonfire           this script
 *   ├── Model         the coiled sword and ash — swap freely
 *   ├── Fire          particle system, playing only while lit
 *   ├── Fire Light    point light, on only while lit
 *   └── RespawnPoint  empty node: where (and facing where) the player respawns
 *
 * ## The interactable protocol
 *
 * Every interactable in Hollow Keep — this, pickups, bloodstains, messages, the lever, the door and the
 * fog gate — carries a TRIGGER volume (its interaction zone, authored on the node like a collider) and
 * implements the same three members. Walking into the zone makes it a candidate (the player's
 * onTriggerEnter); walking out removes it. Of the candidates whose `canInteract` passes, the player
 * prompts for the nearest and calls `interact` on Interact. No distance is measured in script:
 *
 *   canInteract(player): boolean    whether to offer it at all right now
 *   promptText(player): string      what the HUD prompt says
 *   interact(player): void          do it
 *
 * First use lights it (BONFIRE LIT, and it becomes the respawn point). After that, Interact rests:
 * heal, refill flasks, respawn enemies, open the level-up menu.
 */
export default class SoulsBonfireNode extends Node {
  public startLit: boolean = false
  public lightIntensity: number = 900
  public isBonfire: boolean = true
  public lit: boolean = false

  private _gm: Node = null
  private _fire: Node = null
  private _light: Node = null

  onStart() {
    this._gm = this.findNode('GameManager')
    this._fire = this.getChildByName('Fire')[0] ?? null
    this._light = this.getChildByName('Fire Light')[0] ?? null
    this.lit = this.startLit
    this._applyLit()
    ;(this._gm as any)?.registerInteractable?.(this)
  }

  onDespawn() {
    ;(this._gm as any)?.unregisterInteractable?.(this)
  }

  public canInteract(player: Node): boolean {
    return !(player as any)?.isDead
  }

  public promptText(player: Node): string {
    return this.lit ? 'Rest at bonfire' : 'Light bonfire'
  }

  public interact(player: Node): void {
    const p = player as any
    const gm = this._gm as any
    if (!this.lit) {
      this.lit = true
      this._applyLit()
      p.playGesture?.('Souls_Interact', 1)
      gm?.lightBonfire?.(this)
      return
    }
    p.sitAtBonfire?.()
    gm?.rest?.(this)
  }

  /** Where the player stands up after a death. */
  public respawnPoint(): Node {
    return this.getChildByName('RespawnPoint')[0] ?? this
  }

  private _applyLit(): void {
    const fire = this._fire as any
    if (fire) { if (this.lit) fire.play?.(); else fire.stop?.(true) }
    const light = (this._light as any)?.light
    if (light) light.intensity = this.lit ? this.lightIntensity : 0
  }
}
